contract.title: Print a recipe on one page
contract.goal: Add a print stylesheet to the recipe pages of the Larkspur Kitchen blog so that a printed recipe fits on one A4 page.
contract.details: Readers print recipes to cook from. When printing, hide the site header, the comments and the advertisements; keep the title, the ingredients and the steps.

criteria.text: Printing the Barley Soup recipe to PDF gives one A4 page with its title, ingredients and steps, and no header, comments or advertisements.
